note: On a point between the open lake and a bay of Lake Sakakawea, about 15 mi east of Williston near Epping. Three RV loops among pine shelterbelts on a bench above the shore; swim area and day-use beach on the east shore by the cabins. Marina (when the lake is above 1830 ft), four-lane boat ramp, fish-cleaning station, and canoe, kayak, paddleboard, fat-tire bike and snowshoe rentals. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks: 101 sites (41 premium full hookup $30/$35, 47 modern 50-amp + water $25/$30, 5 group, 8 walk-in primitive tent sites $15), showers, flush toilets, dump; base $25 stands (primitive sites are tent-only). Hookups/sites/facilities manual; note cleaned. Lakeview stands (nearest RV pads ~100 m over open grass to the bay; east-shore tent sites don't count). Pin ~180 m from site centroid: fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, not --AWH): keep. The only sites near the water are the walk-in Primitive Tent Sites 50-57 on the east shore (~30 m to the edge of the beach, ~80 m to the water on imagery; DEM 568 m at the pads, 564 m = full pool at the beach), which don't count for an RV. The nearest RV pads, Limestone 35-38 and Sandstone 22-26, look south across ~100 m of open grass to the bay; the Limestone east loop (58-73) is behind a dense shelterbelt ~140 m from the open lake.

BASE: the $15 primitive sites are 'Primitive Tent Site' units set 110-255 ft from parking on grass (walk-in), so the base stays $25 (modern). POLICY ROW consistent (Saturday +$5). Stored reservation_fee/entrance duplicate the state:ND row; left as stored.

MAX LENGTH: reserveNDparks Vehicle Length = Pad Length; modern 40-80 ft (varied, look real), premium 62-175 ft (pull-through drive lengths). Primitive tent sites post 50-60 (placeholder-like, irrelevant). No max_rig_ft written.
